phases.name: Kickoff, subject checklist, and repo baseline

tasks.title: Read subject and build the acceptance checklist
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Convert the subject PDF into a strict acceptance checklist: C++98 build, Makefile rules, config file/default path, single poll/equivalent call, non-blocking sockets and CGI pipes, poll monitors read+write, no socket read/write outside readiness, no errno-driven behavior after read/write, GET/POST/DELETE, uploads, CGI, multi-port, accurate status codes, default/custom error pages, browser compatibility, stress tests, and README requirements.

tasks.title: Create shared terminology and architecture notes
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Farreca leads. Define the words both of you will use consistently: ServerConfig, RouteConfig, Listener, ClientConnection, RequestParser, ResponseBuilder, CgiProcess, EventLoop, and FileResolver.

tasks.title: Repo scaffolding and Makefile baseline
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Create include/src/tests/www/configs layout, minimal main(), C++98 build, -Wall -Wextra -Werror -std=c++98, NAME/all/clean/fclean/re targets, no unnecessary relinking, and predictable binary name `webserv`.

tasks.title: Define module ownership and review rules
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Prepare local NGINX comparison notes plus curl/telnet/manual checks. Use NGINX to compare status/header behavior where useful, but keep your implementation limited to the subject requirements.

tasks.title: Set up local NGINX comparison harness
tasks.desc: Pair task. Confirmed split: Alexandre/paalexan owns parsing/config/HTTP parsing work. João Farreca/jopedro- owns runtime/sockets/event-loop work. CGI and integration checkpoints are reviewed together because they touch both tracks.

tasks.title: Create first valid and invalid config examples
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Create configs/minimal.conf, configs/multi-port.conf, configs/invalid.conf. These drive config parser and early socket/listener tests.

tasks.title: Define config grammar and supported directives
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Write grammar and examples for server blocks and route/location blocks: listen, optional server_name only if you choose virtual hosts, root, index, autoindex, error_page, client_max_body_size, allowed_methods, redirect, upload_dir, and CGI extension mapping.

tasks.title: Implement config tokenizer with line/column errors
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Tokenize braces, semicolons, identifiers, paths, numbers, and strings. Keep errors useful enough to debug configs during evaluation.

tasks.title: Implement parser to ServerConfig and RouteConfig objects
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Parse tokens into typed config objects. Reject duplicate/invalid directives, invalid methods, missing roots, invalid upload directories, and malformed redirects.

tasks.title: Implement config validation and defaults
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Apply defaults and validate final config. Ensure error pages, max body size, route roots, methods, CGI paths, and listen endpoints are usable before the server starts.

tasks.title: Implement route resolution by host, port, and longest path prefix
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Return the effective server and route config for a listener/Host/path. No regex. Longest matching route prefix wins.

tasks.title: Config unit tests and parser fixtures
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Create fixtures for valid/invalid configs and expected parsed models. Include duplicate directives, bad methods, bad braces, missing semicolon, and route precedence cases.

tasks.title: Define shared stub config interface for Farreca's runtime track
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Provide a small stable interface or fixture returning listener endpoints and route basics so Farreca can build sockets/event-loop without waiting for the full parser.

tasks.title: Implement listener socket creation for all configured endpoints
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Create, bind, listen, set SO_REUSEADDR where appropriate, set non-blocking mode, and register each listener in the event loop. Use the parsed config contract once WS-205 is ready; until then use a small temporary ListenerConfig stub.

tasks.title: Design ClientConnection state machine
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Define states: READING_HEADERS, READING_BODY, PROCESSING, CGI_RUNNING, WRITING_RESPONSE, CLOSING. Include buffers, timestamps, request/response ownership, and close reasons.

tasks.title: Implement single poll/equivalent event loop
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Use one poll/equivalent call to handle listener sockets, client sockets, and later CGI pipes. poll must monitor reading and writing simultaneously. Never read/write an FD unless the poll result says it is ready. Do not use errno after read/write to decide server behavior.

tasks.title: Accept clients and register non-blocking connections
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Accept all pending clients from ready listener sockets, set them non-blocking, create ClientConnection state, and add them to the poll set.

tasks.title: Implement read/write buffer mechanics
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Support partial reads and partial writes without blocking. Preserve unread bytes and unsent response bytes correctly.

tasks.title: Timeouts, cleanup, and FD-leak protection
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Close idle/stuck clients predictably so requests never hang indefinitely. Ensure disconnects, bad requests, write errors, and timeouts do not leak FDs or crash the server.

tasks.title: Runtime dummy response integration test
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Before full HTTP is ready, accept a connection and return a fixed valid HTTP response through the same write buffer path. This proves listener/client lifecycle independently from parsing.

phases.name: HTTP parser, routing, and static responses

tasks.title: Incremental HTTP request line and headers parser
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Parse request line and headers incrementally from a byte stream. Handle partial reads, malformed requests, header size limits, method, target, version, and normalized header lookup.

tasks.title: Implement body reader for Content-Length and chunked requests
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Read request bodies with Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding: chunked. Enforce client_max_body_size and return the right error when the body is too large or malformed. Produce an already-unchunked body for CGI.

tasks.title: Map HTTP requests to effective route and filesystem path
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Use listener + Host + request path to choose a server/route. Build safe filesystem paths and prevent accidental path traversal.

tasks.title: Static GET responses: files, index, and autoindex
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Serve static files using Alexandre's route/filesystem mapping contract. If path is a directory, serve configured index, autoindex if enabled, or an error response if forbidden/missing.

tasks.title: Response builder and error page handling
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Generate status line, headers, Content-Length where possible, Connection behavior, default error pages, and configured custom error pages. Alexandre validates parser/routing assumptions.

tasks.title: Method gating and redirects
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Reject unsupported methods with 405 and implement configured redirects before static/CGI handling.

tasks.title: First browser/curl static server demo
tasks.desc: Lead: Pair. Reviewer: Pair. Pair checkpoint. Run the server with a static config, open a browser, run curl checks, and compare basic behavior with NGINX notes.

tasks.title: HTTP parser standalone fixture tests
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Test partial headers, malformed request lines, oversized headers, Content-Length bodies, and chunked bodies without needing live sockets.

tasks.title: POST upload handler
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Implement route-controlled uploads into configured directories using Alexandre's parsed body + route metadata. Decide filename strategy, permissions, overwrite policy, and response status.

tasks.title: DELETE handler
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Delete mapped resources only where route config allows it. Return predictable 204/200/403/404/405 responses.

tasks.title: CGI execution design
tasks.desc: Pair design checkpoint. Alexandre defines CGI trigger parsing, env variables, request/body semantics, and output parsing contract. Farreca defines process lifecycle, stdin/stdout pipe ownership, timeout policy, and one-poll integration.

tasks.title: Implement CGI fork/execve, env, and pipes
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Create child process only for CGI, set environment from Alexandre's request model, connect request body to stdin and stdout/stderr to pipes, handle exec errors, and avoid blocking.

tasks.title: Integrate CGI I/O with one-poll event loop
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Register CGI pipe FDs in the same poll/equivalent loop. Drive reads/writes only on readiness and enforce CGI timeouts.

tasks.title: Parse CGI output into HTTP response
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Parse CGI headers/body, status handling, Content-Type, missing Content-Length behavior, EOF-as-end behavior, and malformed CGI output fallback.

tasks.title: CGI demo scripts and config
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Add at least one simple Python or shell CGI demo that reads input and returns dynamic content. Keep it evaluation-friendly.

phases.name: Testing, stress, docs, and evaluation readiness

tasks.title: curl acceptance suite for required HTTP behavior
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Create scripts for GET/POST/DELETE, status codes, redirects, custom/default errors, directory behavior, uploads, delete, max body size, and route method gating.

tasks.title: Parser and config unit tests
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Add lightweight unit tests for config parsing, route matching, HTTP parser edge cases, chunked decoding, and body-size enforcement.

tasks.title: Network stress tests
tasks.desc: Lead: Farreca. Reviewer: Alexandre. Run scripts that open many connections, disconnect mid-request, send slow headers/bodies, perform partial writes, and test large uploads. Verify no crashes, hangs, or FD leaks.

tasks.title: Browser compatibility smoke tests
tasks.desc: Lead: Pair. Reviewer: Pair. Pair test. Verify static pages, links, assets, error pages, upload forms, and CGI demos in a browser.

tasks.title: Evaluation demo config pack and walkthrough
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Prepare 2–3 configs demonstrating multi-port, server_name, per-route rules, uploads, delete, redirects, custom errors, autoindex, and CGI. Write a short demo script.

tasks.title: README.md and subject-required documentation
tasks.desc: Lead: Alexandre. Reviewer: Farreca. Write English README with the required first italic line, Description, Instructions, Resources, architecture notes, test commands, and a clear note on how AI was used.

tasks.title: Valgrind/leak and norm/evaluation cleanup pass
tasks.desc: Lead: Pair. Reviewer: Pair. Final pair pass. Run leak checks, crash checks, warning checks, clean rebuild, remove debug prints, review forbidden functions, and prepare defense explanation.

tasks.title: Week 1 checkpoint: config + event-loop skeleton compile together
tasks.desc: Lead: Pair. Reviewer: Pair. Both branches integrate. A config file can create listener sockets and the server can accept connections without serving full HTTP yet.

tasks.title: Week 2 checkpoint: static GET demo
tasks.desc: Lead: Pair. Reviewer: Pair. Browser and curl can fetch static files, directories behave correctly, and custom/default error pages work.

tasks.title: Week 3 checkpoint: upload/delete/CGI demo
tasks.desc: Lead: Pair. Reviewer: Pair. Demo config proves upload, delete, and one CGI route. Stress and leak testing can start.

tasks.title: Final checkpoint: evaluation script rehearsal
tasks.desc: Lead: Pair. Reviewer: Pair. Run the project as if in evaluation. One person operates, the other asks questions. Swap roles and verify both can explain architecture and tradeoffs.
